context:
Treat this as a provisioning/lifecycle recovery, not a SQL compatibility
fix. The first gate is service reachability on localhost:9000. Only after a
healthy server-backed tpch SF=0.01 cell passes or fails later in the run
should any ClickHouse adapter/query changes be considered.
description:
RC-1 is the clickhouse-server UAT wipeout: the 2026-05-31 retry artifacts
show 57/57 clickhouse-server cells failed with `terminal_state=no_json_nonzero`
and empty `failure_tail`, so the original run did not expose the actionable
error.

Re-run on 2026-06-01 after the stderr-visible diagnostic fix confirmed the
real failure for the smallest cell:

  BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs \
    LOG_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/clickhouse-server-rc1-repro-20260601 \
    TIMEOUT_S=90 make uat-cell PLATFORM=clickhouse-server BENCHMARK=tpch SCALE=0.01

Result: failed in 33.96s, log
`~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/clickhouse-server-rc1-repro-20260601/clickhouse-server_tpch_0.01_20260601_103610.log`
captured `Code: 210. Connection refused (localhost:9000)`. `nc -vz
localhost 9000` and `localhost 8123` also returned connection refused.

The missing-extra hypothesis was checked and is not the observed failure in
this worktree: `clickhouse-driver` is installed and the diagnostic reached
the driver connection path. The UAT argv is still hardened separately so
clickhouse-server uses its canonical uv extra instead of relying on whatever
the current environment has installed.

Follow-up live repro on 2026-06-01 found three additional server-specific
blockers after Docker was healthy: the local compose stack required an
explicit host-accessible password, the adapter selected `database=default`
before creating it, and ClickHouse server mode attempted to load Docker-host
paths through server-side `file()`, which is limited to
`/var/lib/clickhouse/user_files`. After those fixes plus removal of
session-resetting unsupported `SET` statements, the smallest live cell passed:

  CLICKHOUSE_HOST_PORT=19000 CLICKHOUSE_HTTP_HOST_PORT=18123 \
    BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs \
    LOG_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/clickhouse-server-rc1-repro-20260601 \
    TIMEOUT_S=600 make uat-cell PLATFORM=clickhouse-server BENCHMARK=tpch SCALE=0.01

Result: passed in 10.24s with `submit_terminal_state=submittable`, log
`~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/clickhouse-server-rc1-repro-20260601/clickhouse-server_tpch_0.01_20260601_114205.log`,
and result
`~/Developer/benchmark_runs/results/tpch_sf001_clickhouse_server_sql_20260601_114215_e1a77de5.json`.

Post-fix corpus verification on 2026-06-01 ran the original 57-cell
clickhouse-server non-OLTP surface under UAT-managed Docker lifecycle:

  CLICKHOUSE_HOST_PORT=19000 CLICKHOUSE_HTTP_HOST_PORT=18123 \
    BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs \
    make uat-sweep CONFIG=/tmp/uat-clickhouse-server-rc1-corpus-20260601.yaml

Artifacts:
  `~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_clickhouse_server_rc1_corpus_20260601/matrix_summary.tsv`
  `~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_clickhouse_server_rc1_corpus_20260601/cells.jsonl`
  `~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_clickhouse_server_rc1_corpus_20260601/uat_lifecycle.log`
  `/tmp/uat-clickhouse-server-rc1-corpus-20260601.outer.log`

The corpus executed all 57 candidate cells with no compatibility or
early-stop pruning. Summary footer: `passed=15 failed=40 timed_out=2`,
`run_status=COMPLETED`, `source_dirty=false`. Docker lifecycle recorded
project-scoped clickhouse-server up/down success. The original RC-1 total
wipeout is therefore fixed; remaining failures are benchmark-specific
loader, DDL, query, data-availability, and timeout issues routed to
follow-up TODOs.

Docker recovered after launching Docker Desktop. A UAT-owned compose
project was run on alternate host ports (`19000/18123`) to avoid the
existing debug container on `9000/8123`. The smallest server-backed cell
now passes with a submittable manifest:

  ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/clickhouse-server-rc1-repro-20260601/clickhouse-server_tpch_0.01_20260601_114205.log
  ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/results/tpch_sf001_clickhouse_server_sql_20260601_114215_e1a77de5.json

Root causes fixed in the live path: local compose auth/port propagation,
missing database bootstrap, host-local data loading for Docker-backed
server mode, type conversion for clickhouse-driver INSERT batches, and
legacy unsupported ClickHouse `SET` statements resetting session cache
controls before validation.
